entries.title: Deadlink

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Deadlink launched first on Windows PC and later came to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; the PC version keeps the highest-fidelity, highest-control capture route with no sourced console-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deadlink on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and keep it updated; use the console versions only if a couch/controller route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console ports are later release routes, not separate remasters or definitive editions.
